findings.description: AWS access key and secret access key are embedded in plaintext in the instance user_data script, which is visible via the EC2 metadata service and console/API to anyone with instance describe permissions, leading to credential leakage.
The security group allows inbound TCP port 22 (SSH) from 0.0.0.0/0, exposing administrative access to the entire internet.
map_public_ip_on_launch is set to true, automatically assigning public IPs to instances launched in this subnet, increasing exposure to the internet.
map_public_ip_on_launch is set to true, automatically assigning public IPs to instances launched in this subnet, increasing exposure to the internet.
The EBS volume does not set encrypted = true (or a kms_key_id), so data stored on the volume is unencrypted at rest.
The S3 bucket used to store VPC flow logs has no server-side encryption configuration (aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration), leaving log data unencrypted at rest.

The instance is deployed in a public subnet with map_public_ip_on_launch enabled and attached to a security group allowing SSH and HTTP from the entire internet, combining to create direct internet-reachable administrative and application access.
